preconditions.description: The number of tasks q is between 2 and 10^5.
The first task type is always 1 (add a number to the array).

preconditions.expression: all(t_i in {1, 2} for t_i in tasks)
preconditions.description: Each task type t_i is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= 10**5 for t_i, u_i in tasks if t_i == 1)
preconditions.description: For task type 1, the number u_i is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i, k_i, s_i <= 10**5 for t_i, x_i, k_i, s_i in tasks if t_i == 2)
preconditions.description: For task type 2, the numbers x_i, k_i, and s_i are between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(v in a and k_i % gcd(x_i, v) == 0 and x_i + v <= s_i for t_i, x_i, k_i, s_i, v in zip(tasks, a, k_values, s_values, results) if t_i == 2)
postconditions.description: For each task type 2, the result v satisfies the conditions: v is in the array a, k_i divides GCD(x_i, v), and x_i + v is less than or equal to s_i.

postconditions.expression: all(max_xor == max(x_i ^ v for v in a if k_i % gcd(x_i, v) == 0 and x_i + v <= s_i) for t_i, x_i, k_i, s_i, max_xor in zip(tasks, x_values, k_values, s_values, max_xors) if t_i == 2)
postconditions.description: For each task type 2, the result v maximizes the XOR value x_i ⊕ v among all valid v in the array a.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 if not any(k_i % gcd(x_i, v) == 0 and x_i + v <= s_i for v in a) else True for t_i, x_i, k_i, s_i, result in zip(tasks, x_values, k_values, s_values, results) if t_i == 2)
postconditions.description: For each task type 2, if no valid v exists, the result is -1.
